_meta.what: Layout of GameState.to_vector() and GameState.grid_image() (bloons/obsvec.py, PLAN 5.6). The lists below fix the one-hot orders: a trained model depends on them, so append new entries at the end rather than re-sorting. tests/test_offline.py checks tower_kinds / heroes / bloon_types against towers.json / heroes.json / rounds.json.
_meta.scales: money and costs: log1p(v) / log1p(money); counts: log1p(n) / log1p(count); lives / lives; rounds / round; ranges in units / range_units; positions are normalized content coords (already 0-1). Values can pass 1 when the game passes the scale.
_meta.grid: box = [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the play area in content coords (the swept masks cover x 0.03-0.84, all of y; the shop column is to the right). nx x ny cells, each sampled at sub x sub points. Channels: path (share of the cell within path_half_width_units of the bloons' centre line; 4.5 = the Meadow round-1 bloon band's area / path length / 2, 2026-11-06. Not the map's path.half_width_units, which is the placement keep-out pad, 0.25), one per placeable_classes (share placeable, our towers and the path already removed; 0 if the map has no mask for it), towers (share under a footprint, hero included), ranges (range ellipses covering the cell / range_cap), bloons (log1p(bloons in cell) / log1p(bloon_cap); 0 when observe().bloons is None).
